description_en: Queries the number of applications in the built-in application signature library, grouped by application category, risk level, and technology type. The statistics apply to the global built-in application library and are not limited by Alibaba Cloud accounts or time ranges
description_zh: 查询内置应用特征库的应用程序数量统计，按应用分类、风险等级和技术类型三个维度分组返回。统计对象为全局内置应用库，不区分阿里云账号，也不受时间范围限制
name: DescribeApplicationStatistics

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:
zh: Chinese. This is the default value.
en: English.
This parameter determines whether the category names and technology type names are returned in Chinese or English
parameters.help_zh:
返回信息的语言。取值：
zh：中文，为默认值。
en：英文。
该参数决定分类名称与技术类型名称使用中文或英文
parameters.name: lang

CategoryList.description_en: The list of application counts grouped by application category
CategoryList.description_zh: 按应用分类分组的应用程序数量统计列表

ApplicationCount.description_en: The number of applications in the application category
ApplicationCount.description_zh: 该应用分类下的应用程序数量

CategoryName.description_en: The name of the application category. The name is returned in Chinese or English based on the Lang parameter
CategoryName.description_zh: 应用分类名称，按Lang参数返回中文或英文名称

RiskList.description_en: The list of application counts grouped by risk level
RiskList.description_zh: 按风险等级分组的应用程序数量统计列表

ApplicationCount.description_en: The number of applications at the risk level
ApplicationCount.description_zh: 该风险等级下的应用程序数量

Risk.description_en:
The risk level. Valid values:
Information: Informational.
Low: Low.
Medium: Medium.
High: High.
Critical: Critical
Risk.description_zh:
风险等级。取值：
Information：信息。
Low：低危。
Medium：中危。
High：高危。
Critical：严重

TechnologyList.description_en: The list of application counts grouped by technology type
TechnologyList.description_zh: 按技术类型分组的应用程序数量统计列表

ApplicationCount.description_en: The number of applications of the technology type
ApplicationCount.description_zh: 该技术类型下的应用程序数量

Technology.description_en: The name of the technology type. The name is returned in Chinese or English based on the Lang parameter
Technology.description_zh: 技术类型名称，按Lang参数返回中文或英文名称
